build.buildCommand: set -e; corepack enable 2>/dev/null || true; corepack prepare pnpm@8.15.9 --activate 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then :; elif [ -f ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then cd ../..; fi; echo "Building from $(pwd)"; pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile; pnpm turbo run build --filter=web-main; SA=$(find . -type d -path '*/.next/standalone' -print -quit); echo "standalone dir: $SA"; SRV=$(find "$SA" -name server.js -print -quit); echo "server.js: $SRV"; SDIR=$(dirname "$SRV"); APPDIR=apps/web-main; [ -d "$APPDIR" ] || APPDIR=.; mkdir -p "$SDIR/public" "$SDIR/.next/static"; cp -r "$APPDIR/public/." "$SDIR/public/" 2>/dev/null || true; cp -r "$APPDIR/.next/static/." "$SDIR/.next/static/" 2>/dev/null || true; test -f "$SRV"

deploy.startCommand: sh -c "export NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0; SERVER=$(find /app -path '*/.next/standalone*server.js' -print -quit); if [ -z \"$SERVER\" ]; then echo 'standalone server.js not found'; find /app -maxdepth 5 -type d -name standalone -print; exit 1; fi; echo Starting $SERVER; cd $(dirname $SERVER); exec node $SERVER"
